{{Top|leg}}
'''Quick-draw pulse-wave blasters''' were small weapons with limited ammunition capacity and a short range. They were designed to be drawn and fired in one fluid movement. [[Greff-Timms Industrial/Legends|Greff-Timms Industrial]] produced a model of quick-draw pulse-wave blaster designated the [[SnapShoot DT3]].
